about: Folder extensions that macOS declares as package types, which Finder shows as one item and the disk map draws as one block (isPackageName in src/lib/format.ts). Each is declared by macOS itself (CoreTypes, Photos, Music, TV, Console or DiskImageMounter) or, for xcarchive, xcodeproj, xcworkspace and playground, by Xcode. A framework is a bundle that Finder opens as a folder, so it isn't one. PackageExtensionsTests.swift checks every extension against the types this Mac declares, and format.test.ts reads the same list.
